title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Tell me I'm in the right place, Raleigh, where Auburn is playing
I still don’t know who the pick is but if you’re following him around hoping he’s the guy I’d say you’re doing the right thing!
Liked “I still don’t know who the pick is but if you’re following him around hoping he’s the guy I’d say you’re doing the right thing!”
Are you going to be in Lakeland?
No unfortunately I’ll be running it from home
What does running it consist of?
Oh I just mean keeping track of my guys, who gets taken, where/when, calling agents, stuff like that. Keeping track of things.
A "rival exec" assistant GM just called and said Bart. This is the worst!

The next 20 hours will be the worst. Everyone is just guessing and trying to throw others off the trail, smokescreens and bullshit. Unless you hear it from al/David/scott/someone else in the room it isn’t worth anything.
